caption:
Monaco has signed a shirt sponsor just for its European games.

Local insurance broker Suisscourtage Assurances is AS Monaco's new major partner for the Conference League, with its name on the front of the shirt in European matches this season plus LED boards at Stade Louis-II. Mammouth AI, signed last week, is on the shirt in Ligue 1. Selling the shirt by competition turns a first Conference League campaign into a fresh sale.

Also today: H&R Block x Kansas City Chiefs, e.l.f. Beauty x Tottenham Hotspur Women, Cavendish Farms x CHL.
